This disclosure is not approved. Ziad and qualified counsel must review and approve it before publication.

Service and access

Helix provides AI-assisted advertising research and creative tools. Access is granted manually by an administrator. No public prices, purchasable subscriptions, or checkout are offered. AI output and inferred signals are not verified facts.

Data and integrations

The application may process account identity, workspace queries, public-source creative records, prompts, generated media, drafts, credit usage, and security or audit identifiers. Source-visible integrations include PostgreSQL/Neon, Render, Vercel, Cloudflare R2 or local upload storage, AI services (Groq, OpenRouter, Google Gemini, AIHubMix, Token Harbor, Pollinations), discovery/enrichment services (Adyntel, Apify, Meta, Bright Data, ScrapeGraphAI), and Resend email.

Source configuration references PostgreSQL/Neon and Cloudflare R2, with local-disk upload fallback. The active deployment target, durability, retention, backups, and deletion behavior have not been verified.

This is a source-code inventory, not confirmation that a provider is enabled, used, contracted, or compliant. Deployment, regions, retention, backups, and provider terms have not been verified.

Browser storage and deletion

The current session stores its access token and cached user in JavaScript-readable localStorage; it is not an HttpOnly cookie. An end-to-end account deletion path is not established. No deletion timeline or self-service deletion promise is made.

Contact and approval

The privacy contact and rights-request process are pending operator verification. No contact address is published here. Operator identity, jurisdiction, retention, transfer safeguards, and final English and Arabic wording require approval.

CORE ENDPOINTS:

Authentication: Key generation & X-API-Key pattern
Credit Costs & Limits (Synced with billing_service.py)

Creatives: Catalog queries, swipe files & insights
Media Generation: AI image & video rendering (Gemini)
Monitors: Scheduled loops & event webhooks
Explore API Reference
CLEAR & TRANSPARENT
Frequently Asked Questions

Straight answers on data freshness, credit refunds, trial limits, and scoring formulas.

Why did my search return no results?

Ad transparency libraries only catalog creatives actively running in recent weeks. If a competitor paused their campaigns, or if their ads run under a parent corporate entity or agency rather than their personal alias, queries may return empty. In transient upstream rate limit events, your search credits are automatically refunded.
